# YouTube

> > YouTube is Google's video streaming and sharing platform featuring live content, creator tools, YouTube Music, YouTube Shorts, and community-driven support.

YouTube serves billions of users worldwide with video hosting, live streaming, and music services. The platform provides comprehensive resources for creators through the YouTube Partner Program (YPP), Community Guidelines, and Advertiser-Friendly Content policies.

## Key Topics

- YouTube Creators
- YouTube Shorts
- YouTube Music
- YouTube Premium
- YouTube Partner Program (YPP)
- Community Guidelines
- Advertiser-Friendly Content Guidelines
- Live Streaming
- Content Creation
- Channel Management
- YouTube Contributors
- NFL Sunday Ticket
- Video Production
- Monetization

## Core Platform

- [YouTube](https://youtube.com): Main homepage for YouTube video streaming and sharing platform
- [Watch Videos](https://youtube.com/watch): YouTube video watch page for streaming content
- [YouTube Live](https://youtube.com/LIVE): YouTube Live streaming hub for gaming, music, sports, and news content
- [Official YouTube Channel](https://youtube.com/youtube´): Official YouTube channel celebrating creators and women's history month
- [YouTube About](https://youtube.com/YouTube/about): Official YouTube channel about page featuring creator content

## Creator Resources

- [Getting Started for Creators](https://youtube.com/creators/how-things-work/getting-started): Getting started guide for YouTube Creators on channel setup and Shorts

## Policies & Guidelines

- [YouTube Policies](https://youtube.com/howyoutubeworks/our-policies): Community Guidelines and Advertiser-Friendly Content policies overview

## Community Support

- [YouTube Contributors](https://contributors.youtube.com): YouTube Contributors program for community help and knowledge sharing
- [Google Business Profile FAQ](https://help.youtube.com/intl/streetview/business/faq): Google Business Profile FAQ for managing business listings on Search/Maps

## Optional

- [YouTube Premium Family Plan](https://music.youtube.com/youtube_premium/family): YouTube Premium family plan page with browser compatibility notice
- [YouTube Music Moods & Genres](https://music.youtube.com/moods_and_genres): YouTube Music moods/genres page with browser upgrade requirement
- [GuideRealm Channel](https://youtube.com/c/GuideRealmVideos): GuideRealm channel providing tech how-to videos and tutorials
- [Travel FAQ & Help Channel](https://youtube.com/channel/UCi4pUlFEKftYo10GPH-FCEg): Travel FAQ & Help channel for airline and hotel research support
